title: Number-free selection and piece detail opening verified
summary: Removed numbered markers; select a region for its explanation or double-click/double-tap to open a close-up of that piece.

changes.detail: All nine numbered marker buttons from the realistic phone image.
A single image tap selects a component. Double-click/double-tap on the same piece now opens its detail view instead of replacing the phone cover.

Localized close-up dialog shows the selected image region, role and example. Includes an accessible Open selected piece button, Back to phone, Escape and focus restoration. Close-up enlarges the existing illustration; it does not simulate dismantling component internals.

validation.name: Phone Lab and history regression tests
validation.detail: 10 tests passed. Verified absence of numbered buttons, direct region selection, double-tap opening without closing the cover, and close-up title/crop/explanation. All 24 component families open through the accessible button in English/French/Arabic; Escape, return focus and existing interactions pass.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: App typecheck and lint for photo view and explorer document passed.

validation.name: History integrity
validation.detail: All 195 preceding reports preserved and valid before this follow-up.

validation.name: Live browser and physical device
validation.detail: Actual dialog layout, crop appearance and physical mouse/touch gestures not visually verified. Close-up magnifies the existing educational image, not the hidden inside of a component. No deployment or APK rebuild.
